title: Rosalind and the Bell
author: Vesper Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
